Bruxelles, 31 mai 2026 – Algérie Télécom: Brussels, May 31, 2026 – Algérie Télécom was honored with the "Quality Achievement Award 2026", presented by the European Society for Quality Research (ESQR) during an international ceremony held in Brussels. This distinction recognizes the public operator's efforts in modernizing its infrastructure and improving its services within a rapidly changing Algerian telecom sector.

Abdelghani Ait: The award was presented to Mr. Abdelghani Ait Said, Chairman and CEO of Algérie Télécom, in the presence of a gathering of experts, business leaders, and diplomats from five continents. This international trophy honors companies and institutions that demonstrate exceptional commitment to quality management and continuous improvement of their performance.
